verdicts.reason: Both break the design in the same way. The two hero pasta photos are shrunk to tiny thumbnails stuck in the corners of the peach and pattern background tiles. The ornate frame is pulled out as an empty box, and the plate sketch floats next to it, so the middle of the canvas is a jumble of fragments with no grouping, and the food imagery that carried the design is basically gone. B is very slightly better because its 'Cascadia' wordmark is larger and sits tighter with RESTAURANT and the URL. In A the wordmark is small and the brand block is more spread out.
